name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive.store_rows
type:
∀ (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive),
  row.signature.kind = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.PrimKind.refNew ∨
      row.signature.kind = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.PrimKind.refGet ∨
        row.signature.kind = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.PrimKind.refSet ∨
          row.signature.kind = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.PrimKind.refUpdate ∨
            row.signature.kind = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.PrimKind.force →
    row = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive.p279 ∨
      row = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive.p280 ∨
        row = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive.p374 ∨
          row = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive.p375 ∨
            row = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive.p376

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.Satisfiable.binary
type:
∀ {P : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.Program} (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive) (n m : String)
  (i j o : Benitoite.Release.BaseTy),
  n ≠ m →
    row.signature = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.binarySig n m i j o →
      Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.Satisfiable P row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.Satisfiable.option
type:
∀ {P : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.Program} (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive) (n : String)
  (i o : Benitoite.Release.BaseTy),
  P.DataArity "Option" 1 →
    row.signature = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.optionSig n i o →
      Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.Satisfiable P row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.Satisfiable.unary
type:
∀ {P : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.Program} (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive) (n : String)
  (i o : Benitoite.Release.BaseTy),
  row.signature = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.unarySig n i o →
    Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.Satisfiable P row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.arithmetic
type:
∀ {P : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.Program} (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive)
  (k : Benitoite.Interval.IntKind) (api : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardArithmeticResponse.API),
  Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardArithmeticResponse.API.available k api →
    row.name = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardArithmeticResponse.API.name k api →
      row.signature = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardArithmeticResponse.API.signature k api →
        row.provider.delta = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardScalar.integerDelta →
          Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow P row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.byteString
type:
∀ {P : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.Program} (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive),
  row.name = "Byte.toString" →
    row.signature = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardByteStringResponse.signature →
      row.provider.delta = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardByteStringResponse.delta →
        Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow P row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.character
type:
∀ {P : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.Program} (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive)
  (api : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardCharacterResponse.API),
  row.name = api.name →
    row.signature = api.signature →
      row.provider.delta =
          (Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardCharacterResponse.table
              Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.signatureBase).delta →
        Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow P row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.conversion
type:
∀ {externals : List (Benitoite.Release.Refinement.ExternalKey × Benitoite.Release.Refinement.ExternalDecl)}
  (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive) (k : Benitoite.Interval.IntKind) (fromInteger : Bool),
  k ≠ Benitoite.Interval.IntKind.integer64 →
    row.name = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardConversionResponse.name k fromInteger →
      row.signature = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardConversionResponse.signature k fromInteger →
        row.provider.delta = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardScalar.integerDelta →
          Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow
            (Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.program externals) row.name

name: Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow.decimal
type:
∀ {externals : List (Benitoite.Release.Refinement.ExternalKey × Benitoite.Release.Refinement.ExternalDecl)}
  (row : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.Primitive)
  (api : Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardDecimalResponse.API),
  row.name = api.name →
    row.signature = api.signature →
      row.provider.delta = Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardScalar.decimalDelta →
        Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.PureRow
          (Benitoite.Release.Refinement.StandardModel.program externals) row.name
